citations.title: On technical trading and social media indicators for cryptocurrency price classification through deep learning
citations.authors: Ortu, M., Uras, N., Conversano, C., Bartolucci, S., Destefanis, G.
citations.key_finding: Adding social media sentiment indicators to technical features improves BTC/ETH daily price direction classification accuracy from 51-55% to 67-84% across four deep learning architectures (2017-2020 data).

citations.title: Do cryptocurrency markets react to issuer sentiments? Evidence from Twitter
citations.source: Research in International Business and Finance 61 (2022) 101656
citations.key_finding: Cryptocurrency prices react positively to Twitter issuer sentiments within 24h across 47 major cryptocurrencies; effect driven by incremental change in sentiment tone.

citations.title: How Elon Musk's Twitter activity moves cryptocurrency markets
citations.key_finding: Event study on 47 tweets: significant abnormal returns follow Musk crypto tweets; individual tweets raise BTC price by 16.9% or reduce by 11.8%. Confirms social media causality on crypto prices.

queue.implementation_notes: LunarCrush data already available in project. Use 24h or 7d rolling sentiment score. Long when score crosses upward threshold, flat/short below lower threshold.

queue.hypothesis_one_line: Crypto perpetual futures exhibit statistically significant positive returns during specific UTC hours (21-23 UTC window hypothesised), exploitable as a systematic long-only intraday filter.

citations.title: On the intraday return curves of Bitcoin: Predictability and trading opportunities
citations.authors: Bouri, E., Lau, C.K.M., Saeed, T., Wang, S., Zhao, Y.
citations.key_finding: Bitcoin intraday return curves exhibit predictability during periods of serial correlation; profitable intraday trading opportunities confirmed on 2014-2019 data.

citations.title: Cross-sectional seasonality anomaly in cryptocurrency markets
citations.authors: Long, H., Lucey, B., Yarovaya, L.
citations.key_finding: Significant same-weekday seasonal pattern across 151 cryptocurrencies (2016-2019): past same-weekday returns positively predict future returns, not subsumed by momentum, size, or liquidity.

citations.title: Bitcoin time-of-day, day-of-week and month-of-year effects in returns and trading volume
citations.authors: Baur, D.G., Cahill, D., Godfrey, K., Liu, Z.
citations.key_finding: NEGATIVE PRIOR: 15M observations from 7 exchanges (2011-2017) find no persistent exploitable pattern in hourly Bitcoin returns. Data predates post-2018 hard filter; included as honest prior.
